items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: But God bless him you know G.E. Smith, Tony Garnier, or before Tony, Kenny Aaronsson on bass you know, adjusted quickly.

ctx.x: Well how did he make it known? Did he play something on the guitar to set it up?

Yeah. Or at that time he was playing mostly electric or acoustic guitar and harmonica. Now I understand he plays more keyboard. But at the time I was with him it was always guitar or acoustic guitar. And you would have to watch and listen carefully. Oop, we’re not in G tonight, we’re in B flat. He took it down a step or he took it up a half step you know. Maybe he felt better singing it there or lowered it a half a step to feel better singing. But God bless him you know G.E. Smith, Tony Garnier, or before Tony,…
All right. One last Stuff related question, did anybody ever mis-identify you and Steve Gadd?
